name: Kamoi Nanako
source:
Recurring character.

A high school student who works part-time at [url=/c123784]Kyousuke[/url]'s favorite internet café "Cybaria". She has a hobby of coming up with creative menus with rather strange combinations of products, and she is infamous for forcing the cafe's regular customers to try her creations.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/MISSING_PARTS_the_TANTEI_STORIES]Wikipedia[/url].]
